query_plan.query: What is the median population of German states? Which state is the closest to it?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by state. Return the median population and the state(s) closest to it with their populations.
steps.query: Return all german states with their population, with their german state id and german state name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT german_states.name, german_states.population, (SELECT MEDIAN(german_states.population) FROM german_states) AS median FROM german_states WHERE abs(german_states.population - median) = ( SELECT MIN(abs(german_states.population - median)) FROM german_states )

s1.sql_query: SELECT german_states.german_state, german_states.population, german_states.name FROM german_states
